sources.entry: Strapi - Headless CMS that lets developers build content APIs fast while giving content creators a friendly editing interface. (Source Code) MIT Nodejs
Strapi | Headless CMS to build customisable APIs

summary.one_liner: Strapi is an open-source, self-hosted headless CMS that generates content APIs from user-defined content models and provides an admin editing interface.
summary.what_it_does: Lets developers define content types visually in the Content-Type Builder without code, then auto-generates REST and GraphQL APIs for each type. Includes roles and permissions, a built-in Media Library, internationalization (i18n), and draft and publish workflows. Written in TypeScript/JavaScript with database options listed as SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB. Offers an extensible plugin system and a customizable admin dashboard. Requests flow through routes, middlewares, controllers, and services.
use_cases: Backend API for a website or mobile app
Editorial interface for non-technical content creators
Self-hosted alternative to managed headless CMS platforms
notable: Content-Type Builder for defining content models visually without code
Auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs for every content type
Built-in roles and permissions, media library, i18n, and draft and publish
Extensible plugin system and customizable admin dashboard
No official Docker images; a community CLI generates Dockerfiles for your project
caveats: No official Docker images are shipped; users must build their own, using the community dockerize tool or docs
Hosting on Strapi Cloud is a managed paid-hosting option; the README does not detail pricing
Requirements (OS, Node.js, databases) are referred to external docs and not listed in the README
keywords: give content editors a friendly interface
